tagline: Sun, sand, and Portuguese heritage on India's western coast
introduction: Goa is one of those places that stays with you long after you leave. When searching for must visit places in Goa, you will find a perfect blend of adventure and relaxation. The best places to visit in Goa range from pristine beaches to historic churches. This travel guide to Goa covers the top tourist attractions in Goa, ensuring you don't miss out on the incredible things to do in Goa.

attractions.name: Baga Beach
attractions.description: Known for its vibrant nightlife, water sports, and bustling shacks, Baga Beach is a favorite among tourists seeking an energetic atmosphere.
attractions.whyVisit: It offers the perfect mix of thrilling water sports and lively beach shacks.

attractions.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
attractions.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, this iconic basilica holds the mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier and features exquisite Baroque architecture.
attractions.whyVisit: It is a stunning architectural marvel and a significant pilgrimage site.
